authorization: Direct user request on2026-10-16 to apply both proposed tracks
purpose: Describe where absolute-error and paired-gain contributions accumulate in the already opened Owasco window before considering a model change. This proposal does not establish new temporal evidence or exhaust the possible explanations.

inputBinding.timestampCanonicalization: Read rows[].origin only; parse as an instant, convert to UTC, render ISO8601 with six fractional-second digits and terminal Z, sort ascending, preserve duplicates, join with LF and one terminal LF, encode UTF-8 without BOM. Only its hash is emitted, not the timestamp list.
inputBinding.cohort: The unchanged 1275 saved accepted origin-target rows; no fresh source query, new eligibility calculation, interpolation or outcome-based exclusion.
inputBinding.integrityRuleIfLaterExecuted: The source file hash and canonical cohort hash must match this draft before any calculation. Missing/nonfinite/invalid required fields cause a recorded stop; never silently drop rows or change the denominator.

definitions.N: 1275, the fixed global cohort denominator copied from the saved evaluation; not a per-bin or subgroup count.
definitions.R: The saved same-frozen-ridge-without-fallback prediction. Never recompute it from weights in this diagnostic.
definitions.gain: errorP-errorR; positive means the saved ridge has smaller absolute error on that row.
definitions.gainIsNot: A probability, a confidence measure, an ecological benefit, or a newly trained predictor.
definitions.F_original: The saved small-correction-filter prediction: P when score<=0.100, otherwise R. This rule remains fixed.

boundaryAndArithmeticPolicy: Assign each finite score to exactly one fixed bin using full-precision saved predictions and the same floating-point comparison semantics as the original gate.
Do not round predictions or score before comparisons. The exact 0.100 boundary belongs to B4 and is inactive under the original gate.
No epsilon, deadband, jitter or threshold adjustment may change membership. A numerical tolerance is for recomposition checks only, not bin assignment.
Use a compensated or accurate deterministic sum for reported sums and retain full numerical precision in machine-readable output. Display rounding must not feed back into assignment or checks.

perBin.definition: Number of saved rows in bin j. No value is calculated in this draft.
N_j/N; denominator is the full cohort.
Sum of errorP over bin j.
Sum of errorR over bin j.
Sum of gain over bin j = sumErrorP_j-sumErrorR_j.
sumGain_j/N_j only when N_j>0; describes this bin, not its global contribution.
sumGain_j/N, in mg/L; these contributions add to the global gain.

proposedOutputFields_notComputed.emptyBinPolicy: If N_j=0: count, fraction, sums and global contributions are zero; all within-bin means are JSON null, rendered as N/A. Do not encode a zero mean or a literal NaN in strict JSON. A numerical format that supports NaN may use it only as the missing-mean marker.
proposedOutputFields_notComputed.aggregationRule: Recompose global means from sums divided by N, or equivalently count-weighted bin means. Never average bin means with equal bin weights.

descriptiveObservedChangeDecomposition.unchanged: actual==P using the saved numerical values, with no new tolerance or smoothing.
descriptiveObservedChangeDecomposition.outputsIfLaterExecuted: The same count, sums, within-cell means and global contributions for each bin x stratum, plus stratum totals. Cell means divide by N_j,stratum; stratum means divide by N_stratum; contributions to the original full-cohort score always divide by N=1275.
descriptiveObservedChangeDecomposition.emptyCellPolicy: The same null-mean and zero-sum policy as an empty bin.
descriptiveObservedChangeDecomposition.interpretation: These are observed target-based categories, not claims about exact physical stability. The category is unavailable at forecast origin and must never become a routing rule, gate feature or operational selection criterion.
descriptiveObservedChangeDecomposition.conditionalMedianLimit: A marginal majority of observed zero changes does not show that the conditional median is zero at every available feature vector.

counts: For every bin, its unchanged and changed cell counts sum to N_j.
The two stratum counts sum to N.
sums: Cell sums recompose bin sums and stratum sums without dropping empty cells.
savedGlobalMAE: Sum_j sumGain_j/N matches saved MAE_P-saved MAE_R.
Saved MAE_P-Sum_j sumGain_j/N recomposes the saved unfiltered-ridge MAE.
originalFilterBridge: B5 is exactly score>0.100; B1-B4 are score<=0.100.
For each saved row, the original-filter field must agree with P outside B5 and R inside B5; a discrepancy stops interpretation rather than modifying the original gate.
The original filter's total gain is sumGain_B5, and its global mean gain is sumGain_B5/N.
Saved MAE_P-sumGain_B5/N must match saved scores.small-correction-filter.maeMgL.
B1-B4 contribute zero paired gain to the original filter because it returns P there, even though their diagnostic ridge gains can be nonzero.
recompositionChecks.failurePolicy: A mismatch is an artifact/arithmetic/protocol discrepancy to investigate. Do not change bins, thresholds, cohort or published reference metrics to force agreement.

interpretationConstraints: This is a fixed descriptive table on an already inspected month, not a new test or independent validation.
No threshold may be selected by looking at this table; the 0.1 gate and all five reporting bins are fixed in this draft.
A negative tail or negative coarse-bin sum does not prove that every possible amplitude filter is impossible. Conversely, a positive bin does not establish a deployable profitable selector.
No bootstrap, significance tests, threshold scan, active-only replacement of the primary metric, reweighting, new model or prediction recalculation belongs to this proposal.
The table can localize realized contributions at the chosen resolution. It cannot exhaust the hypotheses about quantization, environmental dynamics, domain shift or instrument processing.
Approved finalized archives and general USGS QA/QC documentation do not establish row-level as-of-origin values, revision timing or operational availability.
prespecificationLevel: Proposed before any bin calculation but after the original primary cohort was inspected. This is not original pre-lake preregistration, adoption or execution.
mission: Research-only environmental evidence for communities; no operational Oracle, governance, funding or blockchain change.
